name: use-stick-to-bottom
title: useStickToBottom
description: Keeps a chat thread on its newest line while the reader is there, lets go when they scroll up, and comes back when they reach the bottom or send.

meta.whenToUse: A MessageScroller thread whose answers stream: pass the reader's newest message id as follow, and keep the engine's autoScroll off.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list that never grows while read, or a feed that should hold its place (a log the reader pages through).
